name: heartfelt
prompt:
Heartfelt, warm vertical family film featuring the exact {vehicle} shown in the reference photos: {look}. Keep the vehicle's design, proportions, badges and wheels identical to the references.
All exterior shots are WIDE: the entire vehicle is always fully visible in frame with generous empty space around it, never cropped, camera well back from the car.
Shot 1 (0-2.5s): wide establishing shot, the vehicle parked on a quiet Bay Area hillside overlook at golden hour, whole vehicle in the middle of the frame, soft warm sunlight, gentle slow push-in.
Shot 2 (2.5-5s): wide shot from behind, a parent and a young child walk hand in hand toward the vehicle, seen from the back, the full vehicle visible, warm backlight, grass moving in the breeze.
Shot 3 (5-7.5s): wide interior view from the rear of the cabin looking forward across the seats and dashboard, matching the interior reference, sunset glowing through the windshield, a child's small backpack on the seat.
Shot 4 (7.5-10s): wide hero shot as the vehicle drives away along a coastal road toward the sunset, bay and hills filling the frame, the vehicle clearly visible in the lower half of the frame.
Photoreal, natural warm colour, gentle steady camera movement, emotional and unhurried. No on-screen text, no captions, no subtitles, no logos other than those on the vehicle, no license plate text. Audio: soft heartfelt piano with warm strings, light ambient breeze, no voices.
